description.narrative: Bilateral RP project in Côte d'Ivoire to strengthen the response preparedness capacity of the Croix-Rouge Côte d'Ivoire (CRCI). As a result, the impact of disasters on people living in vulnerable conditions is reduced.

Côte d'Ivoire. Main areas of focus: - Areas impacted by epidemic/endemic diseases (Lagunes, Sud Comoé) - Areas impacted by the conflicts in the North (Boukani, Tchologo) - Areas impacted by flooding (Bas sasandra, Agneby Tiassa, lagoons) - Areas impacted by inter-community conflicts (Cavally, Guemon, Kbadougou, Folon, Poro, Boukani, Marahoué)

Faced with the unpredictability of disasters and the varied needs of the affected populations, the CRCI, with its limited material and logistical capacities, could increase its ability to offer a prompt and appropriate response.

Structure the logistics, supply and distribution chain; improving the CRCI's multi-hazard/epidemic response in an emergency; position the CRCI as the reference organization through the establishment of a formal money transfer system that meets national and international standards; strengthening the auxiliary role, mandate and legislation of the CRCI; design and implement Disaster Risk Management policy.
